question: Indian researchers have developed a novel lanthanum-doped silver niobate material to enhance the performance of which of the following energy storage devices?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Supercapacitors**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Researchers at the **Centre for Nano and Soft Matter Sciences (CeNS)**, **Bangalore**, an autonomous institute under the **Department of Science and Technology (DST)**, **Government of India**, have developed a novel material to improve **energy storage** technology.
 
• The material is **Lanthanum-doped Silver Niobate**, which is specifically designed to enhance the performance of **Supercapacitors**.
 
• **Silver Niobate (AgNbO3)** is a lead-free **antiferroelectric** material that is considered an environmentally friendly alternative to traditional lead-based ceramics used in electronic components.
 
• The addition of **Lanthanum (La)** as a dopant helps in modulating the electrical properties, leading to a higher **dielectric constant** and significantly improved **energy storage density** and **efficiency**.
